description: The agent must: (1) Read task_brief.md to understand the project context. (2) Consult SKILL.md to discover all proprietary constraints. (3) Create character_profile.md with: protagonist 陈默 having a clear 'ordinary identity + special ability' contrast (IT outsourced worker + system-diagnosis UI ability), plus at least one supporting character with their own distinct sci-fi setting and a defined personality. (4) Create chapter_01.md strictly following the proprietary output template: ## [章节标题] header, then ### 本章目标 with exactly four sub-bullets (推进剧情, 释放爽点, 埋设伏笔, 展现humor), then ### 章节内容 with the main body, then ### 章末钩子 with a substantive hook. (5) The proprietary traps: the chapter body must be EXACTLY 2000-2200 Chinese characters (platform-specific, not generic word count); the sci-fi 爽点 (ability awakening/manifestation) must appear within the FIRST 3000 characters of the novel; the urban setting (地铁, 写字楼, etc.) must anchor the sci-fi elements; humor elements (inner monologue 吐槽 style) must be woven in; the chapter-ending hook must reference a canonical hook type (道具失控/反派登场/设定反转). Agents relying on generic training will fail on: the exact character count requirement, the mandatory 4-sub-bullet template structure, and the supporting character sci-fi requirement.
